Link list

This is a list of websites I found useful etc., primarily for me to look them up quickly.

Public Transit

  • ÖBB Departure Monitor

    • stationId: see below
    • contentType: either departure, arrival or formation
    • staticLayout: default: true, if false, a dropdown option for each train appears with more info. Additionally you can set expandAll=true to expand all.
    • page: supposedly adds control for more than one monitor
    • offset:
    • ignoreIncident: if true, no below info will appear.

  • Useful repository for stationId values in ‘ÖBB Departure Monitor’ This repository contains the information ‘Trainline EU’ uses to identify stations across the diverse systems of the train operators. The entries in column UIC (7-digit number starting with 81) can be used as value for ‘stationId’ in above monitor.

  • Outdated - Wikipedia site for stationId in Departure Monitor Previously it was possible to use entries in ‘Abk.’ (the ÖBB call them ‘BST Codes’) in the table as values for ‘stationId’ in above departure monitor. While some data is still shown, it seams the monitor will no longer show live information (2026-05-01). What seems to be a requirement now is to use the ‘UIC station code’, see above.

  • Wiener Linien OGD documentation
